en.headline: Customs seize 37.3kg cannabis in two airport drug cases, charge two men
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs said officers seized about 37.3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds valued at about HK$8 million in two cases at the airport.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers seized about 37.3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated value of HK$8 million in two separate cases at Hong Kong International Airport.

In the first case on 20 November, a 46-year-old British male transit passenger arriving from Bangkok en route to London was arrested after about 35 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds were found in his two check-in suitcases. In the second case, about 2.3 kilograms were found in unclaimed baggage from Bangkok on 10 August; a 39-year-old mainland man was arrested on 21 November upon arrival from Bangkok via Taipei.
Both men have been charged with one count each of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The cases will be heard at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on 23 November.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗藏毒案 檢37.3公斤大麻花 兩男被控
zh.dek: 香港海關在機場兩宗案件中檢獲約37.3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約800萬港元，兩名男子已被控。
body: 香港海關表示，在香港國際機場兩宗獨立案件中檢獲約37.3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約800萬港元。
首宗案件於11月20日發生，一名46歲英國籍過境男旅客由曼谷抵港準備轉機前往倫敦，關員在其兩個寄艙行李箱內發現約35公斤懷疑大麻花並將其拘捕。另一宗涉及8月10日無人認領行李內發現的約2.3公斤懷疑大麻花；一名39歲內地男子於11月21日由曼谷經台北抵港時被拘捕。
兩人各被控一項販運危險藥物罪，案件將於11月23日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
